name: compact-timing
description: Compacts the conversation at task boundaries instead of at a fixed token count: the model marks the session busy or at a boundary, and the plugin compacts at the end of a turn when the mark and the context size allow it

boundaryTokens.title: Boundary tokens
boundaryTokens.description: At a marked boundary, compact when the context holds at least this many tokens

softTokens.title: Soft limit tokens
softTokens.description: Without a busy mark, compact when the context holds at least this many tokens. Keep autoCompactWindow above this as the hard limit

contextNote.title: Context note
contextNote.description: Once the context reaches boundaryTokens, tell the model to suggest /clear or a handoff when a request starts unrelated work, and to set the boundary mark at the next break when it continues the work

pointerMode.title: Pointer mode
pointerMode.description: At a boundary mark, replace the conversation with one message (the mark focus, the user's requests verbatim, the open user steps, a digest of the work after the last commit, the last reply, the files written, the uncommitted changes, the transcript path and the commits since the session started) instead of a summary. Other compactions keep the summary
